facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 1 to 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: left June 30; earlier seasons: June 27 (2023), July 8 (2024), July 4 (2025)

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: left May 14; earlier seasons: June 5 (2023), June 7 (2024), June 5 (2025)

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: left June 16; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 22 (2024), June 17 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Easy Pass (5,280 ft) and Brown Top (5,850 ft) and the lowest at Beaver Pass (3,630 ft).

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: 95.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 89.3 in (2023), 71.0 in (2024), 87.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: 15.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 34.1 in (2023), 27.0 in (2024), 31.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: 62.7 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 56.5 in (2023), 36.0 in (2024), 50.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between June 8 and August 1, carried from the melt-out dates at Easy Pass (5,280 ft) and Brown Top (5,850 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: melted out June 30, 998 ft below the pass; points to June 18 to August 15

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: melted out June 16, 428 ft below the pass; points to May 30 to July 18
